models.name: brew_images
models.documentation: Durable upload reservations and cleanup survive brew deletion.

models.name: brews
models.documentation: This model contains row level security and requires additional setup for migrations. Visit https://pris.ly/d/row-level-security for more info.

models.name: chat_access_grants
models.documentation: One durable opt-in record per user. Revoking beta access preserves who\ngranted it and when instead of deleting operational history.

models.name: chat_access_settings
models.documentation: The single rollout policy for private chatbot access. It is intentionally\ndatabase-backed: access controls and beta grants need an auditable source\nof truth even when deployment configuration changes.

models.name: chat_conversations
models.documentation: A signed-in user's private chat thread. Transcript content expires after\ninactivity; provider usage has a separate operational retention policy.

models.name: chat_drafts
models.documentation: Versioned, validated recipe state for a chat thread. This is not a saved\nMeadTools recipe and is retained/deleted with the conversation.

models.name: chat_generations
models.documentation: The generation is addressable without retaining a raw provider request.\nUsage lives in chatbot_usage_events and will later be priced by an\neffective-dated provider pricing version.

models.name: chat_message_contexts
models.documentation: References only the user-selected record identity and display label for a\nturn. These references never implicitly reattach account context later.

models.name: chat_messages
models.documentation: Stores only the transcript the user can see. Provider prompts, hidden\nreasoning, and raw tool payloads deliberately do not belong here.

models.name: chatbot_usage_events
models.documentation: Stores request metadata and provider usage only; it intentionally never stores chat content.

models.name: chatbot_usage_windows
models.documentation: Retains aggregate, non-sensitive provider usage for operational auditing.

models.name: credit_accounts
models.documentation: A user owns one account. Its available balance is derived from the\nimmutable ledger; do not add a mutable spent or balance column here.

models.name: credit_checkout_sessions
models.documentation: A pending or completed Stripe Checkout session. Payment is credited only\nafter a verified webhook, never from a browser success redirect.

models.name: credit_fee_policy_versions
models.documentation: Versioned customer pricing policy. This keeps provider cost, payment fees,\nand MeadTools' margin independently auditable and adjustable over time.

models.name: credit_ledger_entries
models.documentation: Append-only financial record for credit purchases, holds, settlement, and\nreversals. A reservation is negative; settlement returns unused credits,\nso the sum of immutable deltas is the final user charge.

models.name: credit_payment_recoveries
models.documentation: A Stripe refund or dispute that affects a credit purchase or premium invoice. The\nprovider amount is retained for audit; the ledger remains the source of\ntruth for credit changes.

models.name: credit_payment_webhook_events
models.documentation: Deduplicates verified payment provider webhooks. This audit record contains\nevent identity only; Stripe's raw event payload is intentionally not stored.

models.name: credit_pricing_versions
models.documentation: Effective-dated provider prices used to calculate the exact cost of an AI\noperation. Rates are integer picodollars per one million tokens.

models.name: credit_stripe_dispute_events
models.documentation: Retains the minimal non-sensitive fields required to finish a dispute\nrecovery that reaches us before its Checkout fulfillment webhook.

models.name: credit_stripe_refund_events
models.documentation: Retains the minimal verified fields required to replay a succeeded refund\nthat arrives before its Checkout fulfillment webhook.

models.name: devices
models.documentation: This model contains row level security and requires additional setup for migrations. Visit https://pris.ly/d/row-level-security for more info.

models.name: equipment_assignment_events
models.documentation: Historical brew IDs survive deletion; one event per retried assignment request.

models.name: inventory_adjustments
models.documentation: Append-only audit rows; write with balance, operation and consumption in one transaction.

models.name: inventory_consumptions
models.documentation: Retain the physical-use identity and deduction after entry/brew deletion.\nBrew and entry IDs are historical snapshots, deliberately not cascading FKs.

models.name: inventory_operations
models.documentation: One request identity per account, including a saved response for retries.

models.name: inventory_stock
models.documentation: Archive referenced stock; preserve quantities and audit records after expiry.

models.name: logs
models.documentation: This model contains row level security and requires additional setup for migrations. Visit https://pris.ly/d/row-level-security for more info.

models.name: mcp_access_tokens
models.documentation: Revocable account-scoped MCP credentials. Only a SHA-256 digest is stored.

models.name: mcp_draft_handoffs
models.documentation: Short-lived, owner-only handoffs. These are separate from saved recipes.

models.name: mcp_oauth_clients
models.documentation: Public OAuth clients registered by supported remote MCP clients.

models.name: mcp_oauth_codes
models.documentation: Single-use authorization codes, bound to a user, client, resource and PKCE challenge.

models.name: mcp_oauth_consumed_refresh_tokens
models.documentation: Hash-only token history identifies replay of a rotated refresh token.

models.name: mcp_oauth_sessions
models.documentation: Revocable OAuth connection; access tokens expire quickly and refresh tokens rotate.

models.name: mcp_rate_buckets
models.documentation: One rolling minute counter per account; no tool arguments are stored.

models.name: mcp_registration_budget
models.documentation: A global admission budget bounds anonymous registration across instances.

models.name: mcp_tool_leases
models.documentation: Expiring concurrency slots survive serverless instances and crashes.

models.name: mcp_tool_usage
models.documentation: Metadata only: never store tool arguments, results or credentials here.

models.name: premium_kofi_link_challenges
models.documentation: One-time proof sent to the payer email before it can claim Ko-fi payments.

models.name: premium_kofi_links
models.documentation: A verified account link to the Ko-fi payer email. The email itself is not\npersisted; a keyed digest prevents a database leak from listing supporters.

models.name: premium_kofi_payments
models.documentation: One verified Ko-fi recurring payment. The message and transaction IDs\ndeduplicate retries; no raw webhook payload or payer email is retained.

models.name: premium_memberships
models.documentation: Account-scoped premium access from a paid period or an operator grant.\nSource records remain separate so Ko-fi, Stripe, and manual grants can\nexpire or be revoked independently.

models.name: premium_stripe_checkouts
models.documentation: Durable Checkout reservation; Stripe requests reuse the persisted attempt and parameters.

models.name: premium_stripe_invoices
models.documentation: One paid Stripe invoice per premium allowance. The invoice ID makes\nwebhook retries and out-of-order delivery safe to replay.

models.name: premium_stripe_payments
models.documentation: Verified invoice-to-payment mapping for subscription refunds and disputes.

models.name: premium_stripe_subscriptions
models.documentation: Stripe customer and subscription identity for account billing management.

fields.name: product_updates_opt_in
fields.documentation: Null means the account has not answered the one-time banner.

fields.name: product_updates_last_emailed_date
fields.documentation: Claimed before SMTP to keep automated sends at most once per release.
